welcome:
👋 Welcome to the Fault Code Interpreter Bot!

To look up a fault code, send a message in this format:
<product> <code>

Available products:
- Q1
- Q2
- T2
- Q3

Examples:
Q1 16897
Q2 0x4201
T2 14592
Q3 17445

For CATL float value lookup:
CATL <value>
Example: CATL 3.247

Available commands:
/start - Show this welcome message
/help - Show help information
/list - List all available fault codes

help.instructions: To use this bot, send a message in this format:
help.fault_code: Fault Code: The code you entered
help.name: Name: Short name of the fault
help.system: System: Which system the code belongs to

errors.or_catl: Or use CATL command for float value lookup:
